vision.problem: A solo developer using AI coding agents loses track of what to build next, why, and where work stopped, because agents forget between sessions and act on every idea at once.
vision.customer: A solo developer, or a very small team, who builds with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex, and installs skills into their repositories.

outcomes.text: `npx skills add https://github.com/purview-dev/pm-skills -y` followed by `pm-setup` leaves a repository with the rules merged, and every pm-* skill and every workflow skill reported installed.
After compaction or a new session, `pm-resume` names the active item, its stage, and the next action from `planning/` alone.

During an active workflow, only the Non-interruption rules' exceptions run (capture, `pm-checkpoint` stage, done, push and pop, `pm-pause`, `pm-revise`, and the read-only views and checks); every other PM skill waits, and a capture replies in one line while the step in progress resumes.
`pm-export` writes a schema-valid `planning.json`, and `pm-docs-site` builds a site from it whose `just docs-check` passes.

outOfScope: Teams and shared boards: multi-user assignment, permissions, or a shared hosted board. PM state is files in one repository.
Non-Bun tooling: npm- or pnpm-only toolchains for validation and the docs site.

constraints.stack: Markdown skills, Bun scripts, just, markdownlint-cli2, GitHub Actions

focus.whyNow: every item in Next serves it, and the brief `planning/briefs/2026-11-17-docs-site-package.md` records copied templates, unpinned packages, and rules bumps for template changes as current costs.

bets.statement: We believe shipping the docs site as a pinned, independently versioned package will make every consumer's site build the same way and upgrade with one version change, for consumers and for this repository's maintainer.
bets.evidence: `skills/pm-docs-site/SKILL.md` scaffold step 5 and upgrade step 4 install the latest packages; about 40 template files are copied into each site.
bets.signal: two builds from the same `planning.json` and lockfile give byte-identical HTML, and a package upgrade changes only `package.json` and `bun.lock`.

inbox.title: Package tests slow the pre-push hook
inbox.idea: R-008 added `package-test` to `just lint-check`, which the lefthook pre-push hook runs. It adds two Astro builds, a pack, and a networked `bun install` to every push: about 40 to 60 seconds, and a push fails offline. Keep it, move it to CI only, or run only the fast unit tests on pre-push?

inbox.title: R-010 deferred board polish
inbox.idea:
Minor findings from R-010's task and final reviews, triaged "can wait":

- The 3s reveal of a pending board also fires on a slow but successful hydration (brief unfiltered view, then the filtered one); say so in `components.css` and the `useBoardUrlState.ts` header, or tune it.
- The pending mark is also set on `/plan/roadmap/?owner=...` (inert today); scope it to the Board page when R-011 adds Roadmap filters.
- `useBoardUrlState` `replaceState` drops non-board query parameters and `history.state`.
- The lane header is a plain `div`; an `h3` or `role="heading"` would make lanes navigable.
- Before hydration, `aria-expanded` is `true` on columns the pre-paint script already collapsed.
- The card list is serialised into the island's `props` beside the rendered HTML, roughly doubling the Board page; watch it for R-011 and R-012.
- A collapsed column's vertical title stretches the shared header row.
- `kanban.css` duplicates the Astro cards' scoped styles and keeps dead `.k-item:focus-visible` and `cursor: grab` (suggests drag and drop); its header comment lists only some changes.
- `board.ts`: repeated `(X as string[]).includes` casts; `lanes()` branches repeat their tail; `lanes(..., 'none')` returns the input array.
- `board-data.ts` casts loose owner strings to `Owner | null`; no fixture Done entry with a null `id` (key fallback, `href: null`, and the Done-tag rule untested); `tagHref` never asserted.
- `integration.test.ts` asserts the integration names two ways.
- `install.test.ts` uses a 60s `afterAll` timeout for slow Windows `rmSync`.
- The `dev` Playwright project adds about 25s per browser run and leaves one temp folder per machine; the optimizeDeps guard is untested under Yarn PnP.

inbox.title: Package dev web server start is intermittent
inbox.idea: `just lint-check` failed twice on 2026-11-18 at `package-test`: the `dev` web server (`test/browser/dev-server.ts`) logged `Listen method has been called more than once without closing` and `transport invoke timed out after 60000ms`, then Playwright timed out after 300000ms. `bun run test:browser --project=dev` alone passed, and a third full run passed, so the start is intermittent when both web servers start together. Playwright starts both servers even with `--project=chromium`. Separately, `bun run test:browser -- --project chromium <file>` fails under Bun (Playwright reads the path as a project name), while `--project=chromium` works.

inbox.title: Milestone timeline polish follow-ups
inbox.idea:
Minor findings from R-011's task and final reviews, triaged "can wait":

- Keyboard focus drops to `<body>` when `Zoom in`, `Zoom out`, or `Reset zoom` becomes disabled at its limit; `aria-disabled` with a no-op guard would keep focus.
- The plain-wheel path scrolls by `deltaY` without scaling line-mode (`deltaMode` 1) deltas.
- The zoom-anchor browser test covers a single click, not two zoom changes before one render.
- The `planned` and `other` card markers are never rendered in a browser test: the fixture has no planned milestone, because adding one adds a milestone page and the spec said no page is added.
- Event de-duplication assumes the Now item is not also logged done or queued under another milestone; untested.

inbox.title: R-021 deferred build and docs polish
inbox.idea:
Minor findings from R-021's final review, deferred:

- `tsconfig.build.json` sets `types: ["node"]`, but `@types/node` arrives only through `@types/bun`; add it to `devDependencies` so a lockfile change cannot break `prepack`.
- `scripts/build.ts` rewrites `.ts` specifiers only in the top level of `dist/`, and the install-test guard reads only the top level; a nested `lib/` folder would escape both (use `readdirSync(..., { recursive: true })`).
- `scripts/check-exports.ts` rejects valid `.mjs`/`.cjs` entry points and accepts a `.d.ts` outside a `types` condition.
- Shipped `src/` type-imports `../lib/types.ts`, which the tarball omits (runtime unaffected); ship it or note why not.
- The `astro.config.ts` examples in `packages/pm-docs-site/README.md` and `docs/wiki/guide/Docs-Site-Package.md` are fenced as `js`.
- `README.md:69` and `.config/purview-docs.yml:23` say `0.1.0-pre.1` is on npm; stale once `0.1.0-pre.2` publishes.
